items.title: Watercolor Greenery Spray
items.alt: One airy asymmetrical bouquet-like spray combines a small round eucalyptus branch, one delicate fern frond and three narrow olive leaves, fine watercolor green and blue-green pigment, no flowers or ribbon.
items.description: One airy asymmetrical bouquet-like spray combines a small round eucalyptus branch, one delicate fern frond and three narrow olive leaves, fine watercolor green and blue-green pigment, no flowers or ribbon.

items.title: Laurel Leaf Crescent
items.alt: One elegant open crescent of two laurel branches has alternating deep green and muted olive oval leaves, slim twigs overlap at the base, large empty inner space, no text or badge.

items.title: Eucalyptus Corner Decoration
items.alt: One L-shaped botanical corner of rounded blue-green eucalyptus leaves with a few tiny pale leaf buds, slender twigs extend upward and right from a compact bend, open inner corner, no flowers.

items.title: Tropical Leaves Header
items.alt: One wide shallow asymmetric arrangement of a fan palm segment, a broad banana leaf and a small split monstera leaf, overlapping naturally as an airy header with complete bounded leaf tips, no text.

items.title: Greenery Oval Frame
items.alt: One thin vertical oval twig frame decorated at upper left with small fern pinnae and at lower right with rounded eucalyptus leaves and narrow olive leaves, generous empty transparent center, no flowers or bow.

items.title: Pressed Leaves in a Nature Journal
items.alt: One small open unlined nature notebook displays three pressed differently shaped leaves: a ginkgo fan, a small fern and a narrow willow leaf, pale blank paper, no writing, complete book corners and spine.
